hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the parameter theta in the latent product V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta) with p to recover the first term and with q to recover the second term. The full raw expression is the sum of these two instantiations.
required_assumptions: V and G0 are unary function symbols.
The product is evaluated symbolically without expanding or simplifying the factors.
hypotheses.rationale: The two product terms share the same repeated kernel V(theta)*G0(theta)*V(theta), with only the symbolic argument changing from p to q. This matches the observed LGG family template G0(theta0)*V(theta0)**2 up to commutative reordering.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the unary function template V(theta) at theta=p and theta=q to obtain the two V-factor subexpressions appearing in the raw sum.
required_assumptions: V is a unary function symbol.
hypotheses.rationale: The expressions V(p) and V(q) are substitution instances of the same function symbol V, so they form a trivial parameterized family.

hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the unary function template G0(theta) at theta=p and theta=q to obtain the two G0-factor subexpressions appearing in the raw sum.
required_assumptions: G0 is a unary function symbol.
hypotheses.rationale: The expressions G0(p) and G0(q) are substitution instances of the same function symbol G0, so they form a trivial parameterized family.
